description: Inverse gamma distribution cumulative distribution function Q(a, 1/x) (shape a, rate 1)

tolerance.reason: F(x) = Q(a, 1/x) and 1 - F(x) = P(a, 1/x), the functions of gamma_sf and gamma_cdf, so they get gamma's tolerance 1e-12, and the condition number |x f(x) / F(x)| is gamma's at t = 1/x. Unlike gamma's x, t = 1/x is not an exact double: rounding it (as SciPy, Boost and statrs all do) costs the condition number times 2^-53. Shapes stop at 1e4, where the largest condition number at a normal result is 3.0e3 (t = a -+ 30 sqrt(a)) and rounding costs at most 3.4e-13; at gamma's a = 1e5 and 1e6 it would cost 1.1e-12 and 3.3e-12, beyond the tolerance, so a correct method that rounds 1/x would fail there. Results below 2.2e-308 are judged relative to that number (conventions). SciPy's worst error here is 7.5e-13 (cdf, a = 1e3, x = 1/(a + 30 sqrt(a))), except one subnormal result flushed to 0 in each function (cdf at a = 5, x = 1/750; sf at a = 50, x = 1/1e-5)
